why_it_moved.text: Before exposure, Test users already had a higher Successful Search Rate, by +0.71%, against a measured lift of +0.81%.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Most of the lift may come from who landed in Test, not from the ranker; the cause of the imbalance is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison that shows no gap, or a re-randomised rerun, would let the +0.81% lift be judged against the 0.5% bar.
An adjusted readout that removes the pre-exposure gap and still clears the 0.5% bar would restore a Ship call.
